† [בִּרַךְ] vb. kneel, bless (so BH);—
Pe. Pt. 1. act. בָּרֵךְ עַל־בִּרְכוֹ֫הי Dn 6:11 kneeling on his knees (in prayer). 2. pass. בְּרִיךְ Dn 3:28 blessed (be) the God, etc.
Pa. bless, praise: Pf. 3 ms. בָּרִךְ 2:19, 1 s. בָּֽרְכֵת (K § 39. 3) 4:31, both c. ל of God; Pt. pass. מְבָרַךְ 2:20 the name of God (be) blessed.
